answer:
John Lynch-Staunton held positions in the **Conservative Party of Canada** (serving as its interim leader from December 2003 to March 2004) and previously served as Leader of the Official Opposition in the Senate for the Progressive Conservative Party.

The current federal leader of the Conservative Party of Canada is **Pierre Poilievre**.
